title: Exact quantum factoring over one fixed finite gate set
exact_target: Is there a polynomial-time uniform quantum circuit family that outputs the complete prime factorization of every integer $N\geq 2$ with probability one, using a polynomial number of gates and qubits in log N and a single fixed finite gate set containing NOT, CNOT, Toffoli, Hadamard, diag(1,i), their inverses and singly controlled versions?
